mapper.select: SELECT sp.id, sp.product_id, p.name AS product_name, sp.cost, (SELECT pp.price FROM product_price pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.id LIMIT 1) AS price, sp.case_quantity, sp.scanned, sp.expected_count, sp.expected_value, sp.actual_count, sp.actual_value FROM stocktake_product sp INNER JOIN product p ON p.id = sp.product_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sp.stocktake_id = #{stocktakeId} ORDER BY sp.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, (SELECT pp.price FROM product_price pp WHERE pp.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pp.id LIMIT 1) AS price, (SELECT pb.code FROM product_barcode pb WHERE pb.product_id = p.id ORDER BY pb.id LIMIT 1) AS barcode FROM product p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_barcode pb WHERE pb.product_id = p.id AND pb.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ) ORDER BY p.name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT p.* FROM product p INNER JOIN product_barcode pb ON pb.product_id = p.id WHERE pb.code = #{code} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
